user.title: RNV Public Transport
user.description:
Enter your tenant ID, client ID, client secret and resource.
To use this integration, you need access credentials for the RNV Open Data API.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure RNV Public Transport
reconfigure.description:
Update your tenant ID, client ID, client secret and resource.
Existing station settings will stay unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the RNV service. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The provided credentials are invalid. Please check the tenant ID, client ID, client secret, and resource.
error.invalid_auth_reconfigure: The provided credentials are invalid. Please check the tenant ID, client ID, client secret, and resource.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.invalid_format: Remove prefixes like clientID= and trailing spaces from the value.

abort.reauth_successful: The credentials were updated successfully. It takes a few minutes until the sensors are updated and working!

Select a station from the dropdown.
Optionally filter by platform and line.

remove_station.title: Remove a Station
remove_station.description: Select the station you want to remove from the list.
